# Vendored libraries

Unmodified copies from jsdelivr, served by the app so it runs offline.

| Path | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mermaid.min.js` | `mermaid` | 12.3.0 | MIT (`LICENSE-mermaid`) |
| `svg-pan-zoom.min.js` | `svg-pan-zoom` | 3.6.2 | BSD-2-Clause (`LICENSE-svg-pan-zoom`) |

Mermaid 12 includes the ELK layout, so no separate plugin is vendored. See "Update the vendored libraries" on the Checks and Docs page of the user guide.
